# truenas_replication_run (Action)

Runs a replication task now (replication.run).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Trigger an on-demand run of a replication task (Terraform 1.14+).
action "truenas_replication_run" "example" {
  config {
    id = 1
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Replication task id (truenas_replication.<name>.id).
